text.description_html:
Salvador 110 Lever with T Rose Mortise Lockset, Corbin Russwin ML2000

The ML2000 Series is an ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 mortise lock designed to meet the rigors of high-traffic, abusive environments. Constructed of heavy-gauge steel with unique, patented features and a full range of trim and functions including status indicators and Motorized Electric Latch Retraction (MELR), the versatility and reliability of this lock complement any application.

Status indicator options offer a unique and highly visible window design and provides clarity on the locked/unlocked status of a door. Available for use with a wide range of trim options and with a variety of functions, the mortise lock status indicators are versatile for any application.

Specifications for Corbin Russwin ML2000 Series Mortise Lockset

  • ANSI/BHMA A156.13, Series 1000, Operational and Security Grade 1
  • UL-cUL Listed for use on fire doors having a rating up to and including 3-hoursUL-cUL Listed for use on fire doors having a rating up to and including 3-hours
  • Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant
  • Backset Depth (Standard): 2 3/4"
  • Cylinder Format: Conventional, Large Format, Small Format
  • Cylinder Pins: 6 pin, 7 pin
  • Door Thickness (Standard): 1 3/4"
  • Handing: Field Reversible
  • Latchbolt Throw: 3/4"
  • Strike Type: ANSI Curved Lip
  • Oil Rubbed Bronze Finish
